hero.title: Explore the Cosmos
hero.subtitle: Journey through the stars and discover new worlds.
hero.eyebrow: Interstellar Travel Agency · Flight systems online
hero.lead: Step inside a living atlas of distant worlds. Compare exoplanets, trace future routes, and experience the research systems that could guide humanity beyond Earth.

routes.title: Every journey begins with a system.
routes.lead: I.T.A connects scientific data, route intelligence, and human imagination into one navigable interstellar experience.
routes.databaseText: Filter thousands of celestial records, compare planetary conditions, and identify worlds worth a closer look.
routes.mapsText: Move through connected systems and see how distance, neighbourhood, and stellar context shape a route.
routes.aiText: Ask questions, interpret astronomical data, and turn a vast catalogue into a focused mission briefing.

passage.text: The future of space travel will be measured in more than velocity. It will be orientation, confidence, wonder, and the feeling that an impossible distance has become understandable.

mission.title: From signal to destination.
mission.step1Text: Search a scientific catalogue built around the questions travellers actually ask.
mission.step2Text: Translate raw measurements into climate, scale, risk, and possibility.
mission.step3Text: Follow a coherent route through maps, simulations, and future-facing projects.

manifesto.quote: The first interstellar journey begins long before launch. It begins when the universe becomes legible.

final.title: Choose your first world.
final.text: The catalogue is open. Your route begins with one question, one signal, and one destination.

footer.tagline: An independent interstellar travel concept, research platform, and invitation to look further.
